medical.intro: Scuba diving and freediving require good physical and mental health. Some medical conditions are hazardous while diving. This questionnaire determines if a physician evaluation is needed. Answer all questions honestly.
medical.pregnancy: If you are pregnant or trying to become pregnant, do not dive.
medical.privacy: Answers are shared with your dive center per PADI medical standards.
medical.q1: I have had problems with my lungs/breathing, heart, blood, or have been diagnosed with COVID-19.
medical.q2: I am over 45 years of age.
medical.q3: I struggle with moderate exercise (walk 1.6 km / 1 mile in 14 min) or swimming 200 m without resting.
medical.q4: I have had problems with my eyes, ears, or nasal passages/sinuses.
medical.q5: I have had surgery within the last 12 months, or ongoing issues from past surgery.
medical.q6: I have lost consciousness, had migraines, seizures, stroke, or major head injury.
medical.q7: I am being treated for psychological conditions, panic attacks, or addiction.
medical.q8: I have had back problems, hernia, ulcers, or diabetes.
medical.q9: I have had stomach or intestinal problems, including recent diarrhea.
medical.q10: I take prescription medications (except birth control or anti-malarials other than mefloquine).
medical.statement: I answered all questions honestly. I accept responsibility for inaccurate answers or undisclosed health conditions.
